title: Removed GitHub Actions ::set-env command
summary: GitHub removed the ::set-env workflow command. Append to the GITHUB_ENV environment file instead.

sources.title: GitHub Actions: Removing set-env and add-path commands on November 16

constraints: Use environment files with a runner version supporting them. Multiline values require delimiter syntax.
Preserve the effective shell and quote expansion; never copy encoded command values directly.

steps.title: Append to GITHUB_ENV
steps.instructions: Replace literal single-line echo commands with the corresponding environment-file append to "$GITHUB_ENV". Migrate complex values manually.

verification.purpose: Review the workflow patch before running it.
